name: Reflow
description: The first clip behaves like a paragraph in a text box that narrows from the right: thin gaps open between its lines and each row wraps its end onto the next line, while beside it the second clip grows from fragments of its own top rows and unwraps back into one picture as its box widens to the full frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: paper
params.description: Paper seen between the lines and the boxes
